test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In how much time can a person cover a distance of 300 metres at a speed of 27 km/h?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 300 m

Speed = 27 km/h

**Concept used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

Speed in m/sec = speed in km/h × (5/18)

**Calculation:**

Speed in m/sec = 27 × (5/18)

⇒ 15/2

So, time = 300 ÷ 15/2

⇒ 300 × (2/15)

⇒ 40

**∴ The required answer is 40 sec.**
